title: Self-play solves every kind: the four kinds whose outcome sits in their fields, the two with none, and the library kind metric change
request: Add the 7 kinds self-play never solves (metric_change, entity_tables, matching, ranking, segmentation, streams, anomaly), each solved and verified the way its own acceptance does, its ledger recorded, failures logged; fix the image variant's fresh-draw label (KeyError on embedded_images).
spec: dclab_rnd/lake/selfplay.py (27.3), dclab_rnd/kinds/acceptance.py (run: kind.solve/accept, accept_engine), dclab_rnd/lake/replicate.py (29.3), dclab_rnd/store/sets/llm.py (M5 self-play trajectories).
plan: Probe one solve per kind in a scratch folder: do the engine runs pass accept_engine, what do they record, how long do they take.
Failing test first: one solve per kind, a failed solve logged, backfill and forget, the image variant's lookup.
Remove the stop on a case with no outcome column; give the library kind its own path; keep no example a kind cannot state truthfully.
Run the CLI with 2 seeds per kind on the real self-play folder; check-quick; reviewer.

decisions.decision: The six own-machine kinds are checked by accept_engine only, as every own-machine kind already in self-play is.
decisions.why: acceptance.run also runs the library solve; running both doubles the time and the engine's run is what the ledger records.

decisions.decision: A kind whose case names no outcome column, or a library kind, writes no examples.jsonl family and no screen.
decisions.why: The families assume one outcome column and the Solution's forbidden list. These machines keep their leaks out themselves (solution.forbidden is empty), so a leakage example would say 'nothing forbidden' on a table with a planted leak. Their ledger is their record.

decisions.decision: metric_change keeps its whole solve (questions, the rules' reading, answers as their fields, truth, checks) in library_solves.jsonl, verified or not.
decisions.why: Its path records no ledger decision; the store keeps every file of the self-play folder, so the solve is captured without a new store rule. An empty ledger folder is removed so the store finds no empty workspace.

decisions.decision: The fresh-draw label looks the kind up among self-play's own kinds, not the registry.
decisions.why: The image variant is not a registry kind; it must draw its image case again, not the text case.

decisions.decision: No label is invented for image solves.
decisions.why: The embedded machine measures no tuning candidate, so a fresh draw has nothing to compare; the fix removes the error, the label stays absent.

change: dclab_rnd/lake/selfplay.py (teaches, _solve_library, _plain, library_solves.jsonl, _label_tuning lookup, backfill and forget), dclab_rnd/store/sets/llm.py (selfplay_problem, NO_OUTCOME_KINDS), dclab_rnd/lake/benchmark.py (truth looks the kind up among self-play's kinds, with the pixel prefix), tests/test_selfplay_kinds.py

findings.defect: Seven of 18 kinds never reached self-play: no practice data for the models.
findings.cause: solve() did `break` when case.target is None, and skipped runs_in_engine = False kinds.
findings.fix: Stop only on a missing case; the library kind solved by kind.solve and checked by kind.accept.

findings.defect: Image solves logged 'no fresh-draw label (KeyError: Unknown problem kind embedded_images)'.
findings.cause: _label_tuning called kinds.get(group's kind key); the variant's key is not a registry kind.
findings.fix: Look the kind up in selfplay._kinds().

findings.defect: Examples for the new kinds would have taught false leakage and split answers.
findings.scenario: entity_tables: its written-later customer columns are leaks the machine keeps out, while solution.forbidden is empty.
findings.cause: examples_of reads the Solution's forbidden list and one outcome column.
findings.fix: teaches(): no examples or screens for kinds without an outcome column or a library kind; backfill too.
findings.test: check_engine_kind asserts no examples; the backfill test

findings.defect: The M5 trajectory said every self-play problem has its outcome named.
findings.scenario: segmentation and anomaly trajectories, now in the store.
findings.cause: A fixed request text with outcome_named True.

findings.defect: benchmark.truth raised StopIteration on an embedded_images row; truth_problems dropped every image trace as unreadable.
findings.cause: The same registry lookup as S2; and masked names drawn without the pixel prefix examples_of uses.
findings.fix: Look the kind up in selfplay._kinds() and pass the pixel prefix.

findings.defect: Forecasting's 200 leakage_judgment examples say forbidden [] while its machine keeps rain_mm (the planted leak) out.
findings.cause: Older: examples_of reads solution.forbidden, not the machine's kept_out.
findings.fix: Not fixed here: a follow-up (read the leakage stage's kept_out for own-machine kinds, then solve forecasting again; the owner's call on the re-run).

measurements.name: new tests
measurements.gate: each kind has a verified solve with 1 seed
limits: one seed per kind in the tests

measurements.name: CLI on the real self-play folder
measurements.gate: python -m dclab_rnd.lake selfplay --seeds 2 --kinds <kind> works for each
measurements.result: 14 of 14 solves verified (7 kinds x seeds 0-1), 2-17 s each; problems 1038 -> 1052
limits: two seeds per kind; the full self-play run is the owner's call

measurements.name: image fresh-draw label
measurements.gate: no KeyError; a label only where the machine measured a tuning candidate
measurements.result: the error is gone; no label, because the embedded machine measures no tuning candidate
limits: a label needs the embedded machine to measure a tuning candidate

outcome: Every one of the 18 kinds now reaches self-play; the seven new ones leave verified decision ledgers (metric change its whole solve), and no example states something its run did not decide.
lessons: Before turning a new kind's runs into training examples, check that each field the example reads is where that kind keeps its decision: a machine kind keeps its leaks in its leakage stage, not in the Solution.
A wrapper object (the image variant) must be looked up where it lives, never in the registry by its own key.
risks: The new kinds give ledgers only; no example families teach them yet.
A run stopped between library_solves.jsonl and done.jsonl writes a second line for that group when resumed; nothing reads the file yet.
